**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The Kubient MSA contains no minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay obligation, or volume restriction binding AP:

- **Services are order-driven** — provided "pursuant to each specific engagement by Customer" under individual Exhibits (p0001).
- **Fees are pure revenue share** on amounts actually generated, with Kubient remitting AP's share within 7 days of receipt; no committed spend, no shortfall or penalty mechanic (p0023).
- **Expressly non-exclusive** — AP remains free to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties, so there is no volume cap or channel restriction on us (p0001).

This sits at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback. Searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and "take or pay" returned only (i) the Winning Bid Price floor that AP itself sets (a protection for us), and (ii) the mutual material-breach termination right.

Two items noted in the rationale but deliberately not flagged under this rule: neither party may terminate during the one-year Initial Term except for breach, and Kubient takes all fees generated during a termination notice period — these are term/exit issues rather than purchase commitments, and belong to the term rule. Also worth watching: since commercial terms live in Exhibits, any future Exhibit should be re-checked for minimum volume or spend language.
